chunks: Which will dissolve everything within their bellies, and their skins.
ai.seo_question: What does 'Yus'haru bihi' mean in the context of the Quranic verse about the Pilgrimage?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this phrase from Surah Al-Hajj vividly depicts the physical torment of the disbelievers, where the 'substance'—often identified as the boiling pus of Hellfire or the blood of idols—melts their internal organs and skins. This imagery underscores the totality of divine retribution, illustrating how the punishment consumes both the inner self and the outer form, serving as a tangible manifestation of the consequences of rejecting faith.
